item: extraStriker picks a different midfielder than the project's data in 5-3-2, and the tests do not check which one
detail: In src/ai/shape.ts, applyExtraStriker (lines 399-436) ranks midfielders by role class (CAM > CM > CDM). Among equal roles it takes the most ADVANCED one first, and only then the most central. In 5-3-2 the right CM (formIdx 6, nx -14) is ahead of the central CM (formIdx 7, nx -15.5), so TAI-01 pushes formIdx 6 into the front line. DAT-04's EXTRA_STRIKER_SHAPES in src/data/tactics.ts names formIdx 7 as the extra striker for 5-3-2. TAI-14's slotRole/slotLineFor turn that into role and line, and TAI-04 defshape.ts (lines 333 and 363), TAI-05 press.ts (lines 423-427) and TAI-06 transition.ts (lines 364 and 453) all use them. I checked this with homePositionAt plus slotLineFor in 5-3-2, ATTACK phase, extraStriker = 1, ball at the centre. formIdx 6 gets a home at (13.8, 0) in the forward line, yet the other modules treat him as a CM in the MID line. formIdx 7 stays at (-1.8, 0) in central midfield, yet the other modules treat him as a ST in the FWD line. This also leaves the right of midfield empty: the remaining CMs sit at z 0 and -12.1. It contradicts the builder's own claim that 'the most central midfielder' moves up. The other five formations agree with DAT-04 (4-4-2: 6, 4-3-3: 5, 4-2-3-1: 8, 3-5-2: 5, 4-1-2-1-2: 8). The unit test 'extraStriker pushes exactly one midfielder into the forward line' only counts how many players moved, not which one, so the mismatch passes. Fix: pick the slot from EXTRA_STRIKER_SHAPES (extraStrikerOverride / slotRole === ST on a non-forward slot), or at least order ties by |nz| before nx, and add a test that the pushed formIdx matches slotLineFor(..., EXTRA_STRIKER) === FWD.

item: Lower priority, a conflict between briefs: TAI-01 reads none of the DAT-04 tactics presets
detail: The TAI-01 brief itself only cites data/formations.ts, so this is not a violation of TAI-01's brief. But the DAT-04 brief and the header of src/data/tactics.ts list TAI-01 as the reader of ROLE_PRESETS, PHASE_OFFSETS, FOCUS_MODIFIERS, EXTRA_STRIKER_SHAPES and QUICK_TACTICS.getInBox. TAI-14's src/ai/tactics.ts header goes further: it says team press adds '+teamPress.pushNx' to TAI-01's block push out of possession, and that every module agrees on one number. shape.ts never reads team.teamPress or data/tactics.ts; it uses its own LOCAL_TUNING focus, phase and quick-tactic numbers instead. Practical effect: team press does not move TAI-01's block, except indirectly when TAI-04's lineX changes in defending open play, and the focus and phase numbers are kept in two places. The lead should decide whether TAI-01 has to use these presets or whether the DAT-04/TAI-14 docs should be corrected.
